alerts.title: Brute Force Authentication Attack
alerts.description: Multiple failed authentication attempts detected from a single source IP targeting domain controller DC-01. Over 500 login failures within 5 minutes suggest an automated brute force attack.
alerts.actions:
1. Block source IP at firewall
2. Review account lockout policies
3. Enable multi-factor authentication
4. Check for successful authentications post-attack

alerts.title: Encoded PowerShell Execution
alerts.description: Base64-encoded PowerShell command detected executing on endpoint WS-045. Encoded commands are commonly used by attackers to evade detection and download additional payloads.
alerts.actions:
1. Isolate endpoint immediately
2. Decode and analyze the command
3. Check for persistence mechanisms
4. Review parent process chain

alerts.title: Privilege Escalation via Token Manipulation
alerts.description: A standard user process was observed manipulating access tokens to obtain SYSTEM-level privileges on endpoint WS-023.
alerts.actions:
1. Kill suspicious processes
2. Audit user account permissions
3. Review scheduled tasks
4. Check for additional compromised endpoints

alerts.title: Registry Persistence Mechanism Created
alerts.description: New registry run key added to HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run pointing to a suspicious executable in a temporary directory.
alerts.actions:
1. Remove malicious registry key
2. Quarantine referenced executable
3. Scan for additional persistence
4. Check file hash against threat intelligence

alerts.title: DNS Tunneling Detected
alerts.description: Abnormal DNS query patterns detected with high-entropy subdomain queries suggesting DNS tunneling for data exfiltration or C2 communication.
alerts.actions:
1. Block suspicious DNS domains
2. Review DNS logs for data patterns
3. Isolate affected server
4. Check for malware presence

alerts.title: Suspicious Network Port Scan
alerts.description: Horizontal port scanning activity detected from internal host WS-112, targeting multiple servers across different subnets on common service ports.
alerts.actions:
1. Investigate source endpoint
2. Review network segmentation
3. Check for lateral movement
4. Verify if authorized scan

alerts.title: Unusual Login Time Anomaly
alerts.description: User john.smith authenticated at 03:42 AM, which is outside their normal working hours (8 AM - 6 PM). The login originated from an unusual geographic location.
alerts.actions:
1. Contact user to verify login
2. Review VPN session details
3. Check for impossible travel
4. Review accessed resources

alerts.title: Unauthorized USB Mass Storage
alerts.description: USB mass storage device connected to endpoint WS-089 which violates the organization's removable media policy.
alerts.actions:
1. Review USB device details
2. Check files accessed/copied
3. Remind user of USB policy
4. Consider DLP enforcement

playbooks.name: Brute Force Response
playbooks.description: Automatically blocks source IPs after threshold of failed authentications, disables targeted accounts, and notifies SOC.

playbooks.name: Malware Containment
playbooks.description: Isolates infected endpoint, quarantines malicious files, collects forensic artifacts, and creates remediation case.

playbooks.name: Ransomware Defense
playbooks.description: Detects encryption activity, isolates affected hosts, blocks C2 domains, and triggers mass isolation if spreading.

playbooks.name: Phishing Response
playbooks.description: Extracts URLs and attachments from phishing emails, blocks malicious domains, deletes email from mailboxes.

playbooks.name: Impossible Travel
playbooks.description: Detects logins from geographically impossible locations, resets user password, revokes active sessions.

playbooks.name: Credential Stuffing
playbooks.description: Identifies credential stuffing patterns, enforces MFA challenge, blocks source IPs, resets compromised accounts.

playbooks.name: Password Spray
playbooks.description: Detects password spray attacks across multiple accounts, locks targeted accounts, blocks source infrastructure.

playbooks.name: Privilege Escalation
playbooks.description: Detects token manipulation and privilege escalation attempts, kills malicious processes, isolates endpoint.

playbooks.name: Lateral Movement
playbooks.description: Detects lateral movement via SMB/WMI/RDP, isolates affected hosts, blocks internal connections, collects evidence.

playbooks.name: PowerShell Attack
playbooks.description: Detects encoded/suspicious PowerShell execution, isolates endpoint, analyzes script logs, quarantines payloads.

playbooks.name: USB Malware
playbooks.description: Detects malicious USB mass storage, blocks device, scans files, collects USB activity logs.

playbooks.name: Data Exfiltration
playbooks.description: Detects large outbound data transfers, blocks destination IPs, captures network traffic, notifies DLP team.

playbooks.name: Suspicious Login
playbooks.description: Analyzes anomalous login patterns, challenges with MFA, verifies geo-location, alerts if risk score exceeds threshold.

playbooks.name: Beacon Detection
playbooks.description: Detects C2 beaconing patterns via network analysis, blocks C2 domains, isolates compromised hosts.

playbooks.name: Crypto Miner
playbooks.description: Detects cryptocurrency mining activity, kills mining processes, blocks mining pools, isolates endpoint.

playbooks.name: Web Shell
playbooks.description: Detects web shell deployment on web servers, isolates server, quarantines shell files, patches vulnerabilities.

playbooks.name: DNS Tunneling
playbooks.description: Detects DNS tunneling for data exfiltration, blocks malicious domains, isolates affected DNS clients.

playbooks.name: Reverse Shell
playbooks.description: Detects reverse shell connections, kills process, isolates endpoint, blocks C2 IP, collects forensic evidence.

playbooks.name: Insider Threat
playbooks.description: Detects insider threat indicators, monitors user activity, restricts access, notifies HR and security team.

playbooks.name: Unauthorized Admin Login
playbooks.description: Detects unauthorized admin login attempts, challenges MFA, revokes session, disables account if confirmed.
